faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.moreQuestions: Got more questions? {link}Feel free to reach out.

questions.question: What is a Forex VDS?
questions.answer: A Forex Virtual Dedicated Server (VDS) is a private server optimized for trading. It runs 24/7, independent of your own computer, providing a stable, high-speed environment to run your trading platforms and automated strategies (Expert Advisors) without interruptions.

questions.question: What’s the difference between a VDS and a VPS?
questions.answer: A Virtual Dedicated Server (VDS) provides dedicated resources (CPU, RAM) from a physical server, offering more stable performance than a Virtual Private Server (VPS), which shares resources among multiple users. For trading, VDS is superior as it prevents performance degradation from other users’ activities.

questions.question: VDS and VPS make sense — but what exactly is a VPN, and do I need one?
questions.answer: A VPN (Virtual Private Network) is an encrypted security layer that creates a private connection between you and your VDS. It protects your data, trading activity, and server access from external threats — even on unsecured networks.

questions.question: Does a VPN really protect me, even if someone gets my login details?
questions.answer: Yes — and this is where secure access really matters. With FXVDS, access to your server is protected by strong authentication and restricted network controls. This significantly reduces the risk of unauthorized access, even if login credentials were exposed.

questions.question: Can I use FXVDS for automated or 24/7 trading?
questions.answer:
Absolutely. Our VDS is designed for 24/7 operation, making it ideal for running automated trading strategies, Expert Advisors (EAs), and trading bots without interruption, even when your personal computer is off.

VDS gives you power,

VPN gives you privacy,

and together they give you peace of mind while trading.

questions.question: Why are FXVDS servers so affordable?
questions.answer:
FXVDS is built specifically for forex trading workloads. By optimizing our infrastructure for trading use cases and avoiding unnecessary overhead, we’re able to offer fully dedicated CPU and RAM at a lower cost than traditional dedicated forex servers — without overselling or shared resources.

All FXVDS servers are located in Germany, benefiting from robust infrastructure, strong data protection standards, and low-latency connections for European traders.

questions.question: Does server location matter?
questions.answer:
Yes — but not as much as many providers claim. Server performance is far more important than simply being “close” to a broker. If a server is underpowered or unstable, trade execution will be slow regardless of its location. High-frequency CPUs, fast memory, and a stable infrastructure have a much greater impact on execution speed than distance alone.

That said, FXVDS servers are located in Germany, offering an excellent balance of performance, reliability, and low-latency connections to major European trading infrastructure — at some of the most competitive prices available for dedicated trading servers.

questions.question: What’s the difference between a Static IP and a Dedicated IP address?
questions.answer: A Static IP is a fixed address that does not change, which is important for brokers who may require a consistent IP for security. All our plans include a static IP. A Dedicated IP is an address used exclusively by you, ensuring it is not shared with any other users. This is available as an optional add-on.

questions.question: Is FXVDS suitable for professional copy trading and trade mirroring software?
questions.answer: Yes. FXVDS is highly recommended for users running professional copy trading and trade mirroring solutions, including Anton Nel Mirror Trading Manager software and similar platforms. Dedicated CPU resources, stable performance, and 24/7 uptime ensure reliable trade replication across hundreds of connected follower accounts.

questions.question: Why is a VDS important for mirror trading software?
questions.answer: Mirror trading software requires continuous connectivity, low execution delays, and consistent system performance. A dedicated VDS ensures the trading manager remains online at all times and can process trade signals reliably without interruptions caused by local system or internet issues.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: This privacy policy has been compiled to better serve those who are concerned with how their ‘Personally Identifiable Information’ (PII) is being used online. PII, as described in US privacy law and information security, is information that can be used on its own or with other information to identify, contact, or locate a single person, or to identify an individual in context. Please read our privacy policy carefully to get a clear understanding of how we collect, use, protect or otherwise handle your Personally Identifiable Information in accordance with our website.
privacy.whatWeCollectTitle: What personal information do we collect from the people that visit our blog, website or app?
privacy.whatWeCollectText: When ordering or registering on our site, as appropriate, you may be asked to enter your name, email address, mailing address, credit card information or other details to help you with your experience.
privacy.whenWeCollectText: We collect information from you when you place an order, subscribe to a newsletter, fill out a form or enter information on our site.
privacy.howWeUseTitle: How do we use your information?
privacy.howWeUseText: We may use the information we collect from you when you register, make a purchase, sign up for our newsletter, respond to a survey or marketing communication, surf the website, or use certain other site features in the following ways:
howWeUseList: To personalize your experience and to allow us to deliver the type of content and product offerings in which you are most interested.
To improve our website in order to better serve you.
To allow us to better service you in responding to your customer service requests.
To send periodic emails regarding your order or other products and services.
To follow up with them after correspondence (live chat, email or phone inquiries)
privacy.howWeProtectTitle: How do we protect your information?
privacy.howWeProtectText: Our website is scanned on a regular basis for security holes and known vulnerabilities in order to make your visit to our site as safe as possible. We use regular Malware Scanning. Your personal information is contained behind secured networks and is only accessible by a limited number of persons who have special access rights to such systems, and are required to keep the information confidential. In addition, all sensitive/credit information you supply is encrypted via Secure Socket Layer (SSL) technology. We implement a variety of security measures when a user places an order enters, submits, or accesses their information to maintain the safety of your personal information. All transactions are processed through a gateway provider and are not stored or processed on our servers.
privacy.cookiesText: Yes. Cookies are small files that a site or its service provider transfers to your computer’s hard drive through your Web browser (if you allow) that enables the site’s or service provider’s systems to recognize your browser and capture and remember certain information. For instance, we use cookies to help us remember and process the items in your shopping cart. They are also used to help us understand your preferences based on previous or current site activity, which enables us to provide you with improved services. We also use cookies to help us compile aggregate data about site traffic and site interaction so that we can offer better site experiences and tools in the future.
privacy.thirdPartyDisclosureText: We do not sell, trade, or otherwise transfer to outside parties your Personally Identifiable Information.
privacy.thirdPartyLinksText: We do not include or offer third-party products or services on our website.
privacy.gdprText: If you are a resident of the European Union, you have the right to access the personal information we hold about you, to port it to a new service, and to ask that your personal information be corrected, updated, or erased. If you would like to exercise these rights, please contact us.

cookies.title: Cookie Policy
cookies.intro: To make this site work properly, we sometimes place small data files called cookies on your device. Most big websites do this too. This policy explains what cookies are and how we use them.
cookies.whatAreCookiesText: A cookie is a small text file that a website saves on your computer or mobile device when you visit the site. It enables the website to remember your actions and preferences (such as login, language, and other display preferences) over a period of time, so you don’t have to keep re-entering them whenever you come back to the site or browse from one page to another. The cookie-related information is not used to personally identify you, and the data is fully under our control. These cookies are not used for any purpose other than those described here.
cookies.howWeUseIntro: We use cookies to enhance your browsing experience by:

howWeUseList.title: Necessary Cookies
howWeUseList.text: These are essential for you to browse the website and use its features, such as accessing secure areas of the site. Disabling these cookies may affect site functionality.

howWeUseList.title: Functionality Cookies
howWeUseList.text: These cookies allow the website to remember choices you have made in the past, like what language you prefer or your user name for automatic login.

howWeUseList.title: Performance/Analytics Cookies
howWeUseList.text: We use these cookies to collect information about how you use our website, such as which pages you visited and which links you clicked on. This information is aggregated and anonymized and is used to improve our website's functionality.

cookies.enablingText: Enabling these cookies is not strictly necessary for the website to work but it will provide you with a better browsing experience.
cookies.howToControlText: You can control and/or delete cookies as you wish. You can delete all cookies that are already on your computer and you can set most browsers to prevent them from being placed. If you do this, however, you may have to manually adjust some preferences every time you visit a site and some services and functionalities may not work. For more details, see {link}.
cookies.changesToPolicyText: We may update our Cookie Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new Cookie Policy on this page. You are advised to review this Cookie Policy periodically for any changes.
